info.title: Zoho Writer Universal API
info.description: Create, merge, combine, sign, and manage Writer documents

post.description: Combines documents and delivers them via webhook in Zoho Writer.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

files.description: PDF files to combine. Provide either files or urls; Zoho requires at least 2 PDFs and allows up to 20.

files1.description: Second PDF file to combine. Use together with files for the required two-file minimum.

urls.description: Comma-separated public PDF URLs to combine. Provide either urls or files.

webhook.description: JSON string describing the required webhook target, including invoke_url and any optional retry or header fields.

outputSettings.description: JSON string for optional output_settings such as name and page_number_settings.
